scope: Improve the existing finite-command prototype and reproducible Pi packaging. Missing UC-05/06/07/09/10 remain explicit open requirements; no silent scope reduction.
hypothesis: At unchanged model capacity, source-balanced continuation and model-independent semantic label repair improve natural-command coverage versus matched uniform sampling.
architecture: Unchanged single 160-channel depthwise temporal CNN, five dilated residual blocks, mean/max pooling, existing attention finite heads; 579963 checkpoint parameters. No ASR/STT, phonetic or text decoder, large teacher, ensemble or synthetic expansion.
validation: Existing development selection speakers select checkpoint/arm. Existing development policy_fit plus reserved calibration speakers fit thresholds; enrollment pairs excluded. Same min20 accepts and 95% finite precision, color99%, UNKNOWN family <=1%.
tests: Lock before evaluating chosen E18 arm and frozen E13 human_keywords control on both unchanged historical and revised semantic-overlay test references, direct and Silero. Historical test already examined; no fresh-human-generalization claim. Numeric stress and custom enrollment separate.

resource_targets.device: Raspberry Pi 4, 2 GB RAM, 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS
resource_targets.purpose: Proposed prototype budgets, not assignment-supplied limits; physical measurement required

outputs.source: scripts/train/prototype*.py; scripts/test/prototype*.py; scripts/*_prototype.py; publish.py; scripts/runtime/benchmark.py; scripts/runtime/launcher.py; scripts/modules.json

preservation: No original manifest/audio/installed bundle modification, no live microphone or physical actions, no git commit. Old scripts and locks preserved.
ignore_gate: Existing committed .gitignore protects cache/dist/weights/audio and exposes source/protocol/audit metadata.
evidence_limitations: Semantic overlay remains programmatic silver; human listening not performed
Same historical speakers/utterances are not a fresh blind test
Custom catalog is a small public-data proxy, not user household playlists
